name: lists
note: ADR 0016 Shelf-B `lists` bundle — the COMPLETE, multi-directional relational `append/3` and `length/2` over CONS-CELL lists (`[H|T]` = Tuple[Atom('.'), H, T]; nil = Atom('[]')). These are ordinary account `Rule` nodes the EXISTING check() verifies as the §7 dual-conformance derivations (zero new trusted code). The deterministic `append`/`length` builtins in core/rs/src/builtins.rs are A1 FAST PATHS of the same meaning (ADR 0016 Tie-break #1): for `append`, the builtin's answer is BYTE-IDENTICAL to this clause form (proven by vectors/append_length_differential.json); the clause form ADDITIONALLY supports the generative split (`append(X, Suffix, Whole)`) the builtin cannot. `length` counts with `is/2` over the FROZEN ontos/data `int` embedding (`int(N)` = Tuple[Atom('int'), Atom(<sign||magnitude>)], §5.1) — so the base case is `length([], int(0))` and the step is `N is N1 + 1`; the differential records that this clause yields the `int(3)` EMBEDDING where the legacy builtin yields the Stage-A SPELLING atom `Atom('3')` (same number, two representations — a reconciliation the builtin owns, tracked separately). `program_digest` = lowercase-hex SHA-256(PROGRAM_PREFIX 'logos/account/program/v1\n' || concat of len-prefixed SORTED ontos-codec(quote(clause-as-term)) bytes), recomputed and verified by load_prelude. Each clause `id` = ClauseId::canonical. Term notation as in vectors/account.json: term = {atom:<hex>}|{atom_str:<utf8>}|{tuple:[...]}|{var:<id>}; goal = {pred:<utf8>, args:[term...]}; negated body literal = {neg:<goal>}. The `int` payloads here are: int(0)=atom 00, int(1)=atom 0001 (sign byte 0x00 then big-endian minimal magnitude).
